QuestInfo.name: High Rolling
QuestInfo.0: You made it to level 200. Finally, you've returned to your former power.
QuestInfo.1: You need a new car! The greatest thief in the multiverse can't show up in the same car from Level 100! Preposterous! #p1401000# will certainly understand!
QuestInfo.2: #p1401000# already has a car ordered for you. That manservant really knows his master's heart in and out!

0.0: I am all-powerful once again! It feels so good to be back! What should I do to celebrate? Kill Horntail? Pink Bean?
0.1: Actually, I'm in too good of a mood to be violent. On occasions like these, one must indulge in luxuries of all kinds... I need a new car!

yes.0: Break open the vaults, #p1401000#, you have some ordering to do!

no.0: Well, it's not like I hate my old car. It's a classic. Maybe I should think of something else to celebrate with.
